## Batch 13 authored

Updated the A/B pages, manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, notes, cross-batch dependency record, and five per-item Step‑1 readiness records. The seven existing published A items remain unchanged as owner-declared context.

## Checks

The five items pass precheck, strict proof-contract validation and proof-layout (12 steps, 0 defects). Scoped dependency levels are `0, 0, 0, 1, 1`; renderer and content-policy checks pass, and all four full-text sources are fetch-verified. The sources, locators and dispositions are recorded in [batch coverage](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-13.coverage.json>): [Neaime](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1810.12053v1), [Hu–Mathas](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1304.0906v3), [Mathas’s lecture notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1310.2142), and [Craven’s lecture notes](https://web.mat.bham.ac.uk/D.A.Craven/docs/lectures/groupsgeomreptheory2013.pdf).

Their required interfaces and affected claims are recorded in [cross-batch dependencies](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-13.cross-batch-dependencies.json>).
